summary: St. Louis County stairway lookout moved from Budd Hill in Lake County; the booklets differ by a year on the move, and it is listed as gone.

facts.design: Stairway tower by McClintock Marshall Co.
facts.status_note: Listed as gone by the Forest Fire Lookout Association.

events.note: Lake County booklet says the Budd Hill tower was moved to the Argus site in 1958.
St. Louis County booklet gives 1959 as the date for the Argus tower.

evidence.supports: Argus tower: 1959 date, 79.5 feet, stairway type
tower built by McClintock Marshall Co.
Argus is the relocated Budd Hill tower from Lake County

evidence.supports: Budd Hill tower moved to the Argus site in 1958

evidence.supports: the Budd Hill tower was an 80-foot stairway tower, number 106

resolved_conflicts.field: year moved to the Argus site
resolved_conflicts.explanation: The Lake County booklet gives 1958 for the move; the St. Louis County booklet gives 1959 as the Argus tower's date. The story reports both years.

sources.title: Minnesota Fire Lookout Towers: St. Louis County
Minnesota Fire Lookout Towers: Lake County

notes_for_editor: Only the two county booklets and the FFLA list were found. No removal date, staffing, fire history or site description for the current location. The Lake County booklet's Budd Hill entry carries a 1976 survey note that the fire tower was gone; it sits under the original Budd Hill site, not Argus, so it is not used. The owner code 'Mn MFS' is not expanded in the fetched text.
